slices.focus: Despite program improvements, spring exhaustion hits again. Colleen takes real vacation days and sets evening email boundaries.
slices.summary: A stacked week of school visits plus family errands leaves Colleen flattened. She sees a doctor who names the pattern as recurring seasonal exhaustion. Colleen takes two actual vacation days (not pseudo-rest), sets firmer evening email limits, and commits to preemptive spring recovery planning. She recognizes that better systems reduce chaos but don't change the total demand on her body, and that this distinction matters.
open_loops: Two-day spring recovery block as pre-planned annual practice
Evening email rule: nonurgent replies wait until morning
Personal signal for tipping point (resentment at harmless emails, wired-tired three nights in a row)
